title: Predicting, Fast and Slow: SSD Already Knows Which Guess Is Wrong
abstract: arXiv:2611.19457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Heimdall, a learned controller, calls slow on 52% of an SSD's reads when 30% are slow. Uncertainty estimators, the remedy prescribed for its wrong guesses, cannot find them: nine of them do no better than a coin. The drive can. On one trace, 2% of the reads of 4 to 8 KiB that found less than 4 KiB outstanding while the drive was answering came back slow, and Heimdall called 96% of them slow. A 4,096-entry table of how the drive's recent reads came back, untrained and 21 ns a decision, ranks the wrong guesses at a median AUROC of 0.68 on 57 held-out traces, where the nine sit at 0.46 to 0.52, and it predicts slow reads better than Heimdall itself.

translated_title: 快与慢的预测：SSD 早已知道哪个猜测是错的
translated_abstract: Heimdall 是一个学习型控制器，当 SSD 实际上有 30% 的读取为慢速时，它会对 52% 的读取判定为“慢”。针对其错误猜测，人们开出的补救方案是不确定性估计器，但它们找不出这些错误：九种估计器的表现甚至不比抛硬币好。而硬盘本身可以做到。在某条追踪记录上，4 至 8 KiB 大小的读取中有 2%——即在硬盘应答期间发现未完成读取量少于 4 KiB 的那些——返回缓慢，Heimdall 将其中 96% 判定为“慢”。一张仅含 4,096 条目、记录硬盘近期读取返回情况的表，无需训练、每次决策仅需 21 纳秒，在 57 条留出追踪记录上以 0.68 的中位 AUROC 对错误猜测进行排序，而九种不确定性估计器仅为 0.46 至 0.52，并且它对慢速读取的预测甚至优于 Heimdall 自身。
tldr: 论文发现 SSD 内部一张免训练的 4,096 条目小型查找表就能准确识别学习型控制器对慢速读取的错误猜测，中位 AUROC 达 0.68，远超九种不确定性估计器，甚至比 Heimdall 自身更能预测慢速读取。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that a small untrained 4,096-entry table inside the SSD can identify which slow-read guesses by learned controllers are wrong, achieving a median AUROC of 0.68 that outperforms nine uncertainty estimators and even Heimdall itself at predicting slow reads.
